Name: Profile for Imagery Access
Description: The PIXQLA TRE provides pixel quality metadata encoded within one or more NITF Image Segments that relate to pixel values recorded in one or more ther Image Segments.

NUMAIS.Name: Length of User-defined Data
NUMAIS.Description: This field designates the number of IS(s)associated with the PQS. If NUMAIS = ALL, then the PQS is associated with allIS(s)in the NITF dataset except those with ICAT = PIXQUAL. If NUMAIS = ALL,the conditional field(s) AISDLVL is(are)omitted from this TRE. Otherwise, NUMAIS is a number between 001 and 999 and is no more than the actual number of non-pixel-quality IS(s)in the dataset.

AISDLVL.Name: Associated Image Segment Display Level
AISDLVL.Description: This field identifies the Image Display Level (IDLVL) of each IS associated with the PQS. AISDLVLn values must correspond to IDLVL values of ISs included in the same dataset. The field is repeated NUMAIS times.

NPIXQUAL.Name: Number of Pixel Quality Conditions
NPIXQUAL.Description: This field designates the number of pixel quality conditions represented by the per-pixel values in the PQS. This value exactly equals the number of bits used to encode pixel quality.  The first pixel quality condition is encoded in the least significant bit, with subsequent pixel quality conditions encoded in sequentially more significant bits. Data providers should avoid using different bits to encode pixel conditions that are exact opposites of each other.

PQ_BIT_VALUE.Name: Pixel Quality Bit Value
PQ_BIT_VALUE.Description: This field identifies the value of the nthbit when the PQ_CONDITIONn is present.

PQ_CONDITION.Name: Pixel Quality Condition
PQ_CONDITION.Description: This field identifies the value of the nthbit when the PQ_CONDITIONn is present.
